summary: Chubb Limited filed an 8-K reporting the public offering of C$800M in senior notes by its subsidiary Chubb INA Holdings LLC, fully guaranteed by Chubb. The offering includes C$400M of 3.780% notes due 2031 and C$400M of 4.034% notes due 2033, sold under an underwriting agreement. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No activist, M&A, or restructuring involved. The filing merely notes the sale and attached exhibits. No special-situation analysis or risk-arb angle applies.
